title: CFTC proposes new federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trading
snippet: The CFTC launched rulemaking on leveraged and margined retail crypto trading, proposing Regulation CTX and CAM and a new "crypto asset market" exchange.

title: SEC publishes new crypto custody rules
snippet: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has proposed new rules designed to establish a dedicated legal framework for crypto custody within the wealth management and advisory market

title: Treasury Kills Crypto 'Unhosted Wallet' and Mixer Surveillance Rules
snippet: FinCEN withdrew a 2020 proposal to track transactions with self-custodial crypto wallets and a 2023 plan to designate crypto mixing as a primary money laundering concern.
